Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/types.ts:30

Lazily-loaded node-material context — the renderer is WebGPURenderer (WebGPU or forced-WebGL backend), whose node pipeline rejects classic GLSL ShaderMaterials. Every custom-shaded surface (fresnel limbs, boundary shells, the accretion disc) is therefore built as a node material: bootstrap injects the TSL namespace and the node material ctor so the body builders stay pure/mockable.
